title: Frisk In Minecraft!
description: A Minecraft Datapack that adds Frisk from the hit game Undertale to the game!
body:
This is a Datapack that adds the character Frisk from Undertale in Minecraft!

Includes:

    Saving and Loading
    Custom Armour
    Custom Weapons
    Increasing Stats By Killing Enemies

!only one player can be Frisk at once, or else it causes glitches!

How to use it: Simply install the Datapack and put it in your datapacks and resourcepacks and enable it. (if you're playing on a server put it as a required Resource pack.) and use this command once for the player you want to be Frisk!

/tag <name> add frisk

and that's it!

How to use:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Kill enemies to gain EXP, once you get enough EXP your LOVE will increase.

Once you have saved at least once, hold shift until you hear a sound and firefly particles appear and then press right click to load.

run **/trigger inventory** to change your equipment and view your stats.

run **/trigger reset** to reset your EXP, LOVE, weapons, armour, and stats back to zero.

run **/trigger tutorial** to reread the tutorial
</details>
